title: Scribe: per-(type, year) counters and TYPE-YEAR-seq ID format
problem: Scribe uses a single global integer counter shared by all note types. Bare numeric IDs do not indicate the type, and the counter grows unbounded.
description: 1. Replace the global integer counter with per-(type, year) counters. New file layout: each type folder gains per-year subfolders with index.jsonl, next_seq counter file, and <seq>.md body files. Counter file at <state-dir>/<type>/<year>/next_seq with FileLock. 2. New index entry shape: drop integer 'id', add display_id (e.g. 'T-2026-1'), type, year, seq fields. Type prefixes: T=todo, H=handoff, D=decision, W=wishlist, R=reference, B=blocker, C=context, G=general, L=learning. 3. Generalize _parse_id_arg to accept TYPE-YEAR-seq for every prefix. Bare int and L<n> accepted via migration_id_map.json for one release. 4. Add _format_id(entry) helper, wire through cmd_list/get/done/update/archive and core/startup.py. 5. Year detection: new notes use current UTC year. 6. Tests: per-(type,year) counter independence, year rollover, _parse_id_arg all prefixes, _format_id, list aggregates across year subfolders.
